attr.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past Redux
attr.desc: A native reimplementation of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, built from the snesrev/zelda3 project. Adds widescreen support, a higher-resolution world map, and a range of quality-of-life options over the original SNES game. You must provide your own US ROM; the game's assets are rebuilt on the device the first time you launch, so no PC-side extraction is required.
attr.inst: Put a US 'A Link to the Past' ROM named zelda3.sfc in ports/zelda-lttp/ (a matching ROM in your snes folder is also detected), then launch; the assets are built on first run. You can instead drop a prebuilt zelda3_assets.dat into ports/zelda-lttp/.
